en.hubeali: H 14853 – From him, from one of his companions, from Ziyad Al-Qindy, from Durust Bin Abu Mansour, from a man, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws having said that:
‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has an Angel, whose span between his ear lobe to his shoulder is of five hundred years of the travel distance of a bird’.
en.sarwar: 406. From him, from one of his companions, from Ziyad Al-Qindy, from Durust Bin Abu Mansour, from a man, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) having said that:
‘Allah (azwj) has an Angel, whose span between his ear lobe to his shoulder is of five hundred years of the travel distance of a bird’.
